class.name: EntityDefinition
class.brief_description: Reusable description of a scene-based map entity.
class.description: Associates a stable map classname and description with a [PackedScene]. Save this resource and add its path to [member ProjectSettings.trenchbroom/general/entity_definitions] to configure it for future native TrenchBroom integration. This resource only stores the definition. It does not instantiate the scene, validate classnames, or export FGD files.

members.member: Stable identifier intended for the map's [code skip-lint]classname[/code] key, such as [code]item_health[/code]. Choose a unique identifier within the project's entity definitions and keep it stable when renaming or moving scene files.
Human-readable description intended for the map editor. May contain multiple lines.
Scene representing this entity. Assigning it stores a reference without instantiating it. Scene-based 3D entities should use a [Node3D]-derived root.
